title: Tianji Fragment
next_chapter_hook: The assisting spirit's remnant soul had begun to dissipate, his final words echoing like a curse—'The next reversal of fate will no longer be blurred foresight, but the shattering of the soul.'

text.content: The moment the Jade Pendant touched his palm, Chen Ji felt a scalding hot current surge from his palm into his meridians, as if countless tiny insects were racing and gnawing through his blood vessels. He下意识想要松手，但那玉佩仿佛长在了掌心，甩不掉，抛不开。\n\n血脉印记散发出幽蓝色的微光，与他体内沉睡的陈家血脉产生共鸣。这一刻，他终于明白为何从小到大，这枚玉佩从未离开过他的梦境——那是血脉在呼唤血脉，是宿命在标记它的容器。

dialogue.content: "Brother, you've finally touched it." Chen Nian's voice rang from the depths of his heart, carrying a barely perceptible trace of pity. "You thought this was a fortunate opportunity, but you didn't realize it was a shackle."

text.content: The assisting spirit's remnant soul walked closer, his form flickering in the dim light like he might dissolve into nothingness at any moment. In his withered palm, he held a piece of torn cloth, its patterns unmistakably matching the Tianji Record.\n\nWhen the fragment approached the Jade Pendant, an ear-piercing hum erupted in the air, lightning flickering between the two relics as if they were fighting, yet also merging. Chen Ji felt an invisible force slam against his crown, and countless fragmented images suddenly flashed before his eyes—

He saw a grand altar, thousands of figures kneeling on the ground, each bearing the same markings on their chests as the one on his palm. He saw a massive eye descending from the void, its pupils reflecting countless threads of fate. He saw his father, kneeling at the same altar, holding the Jade Pendant in both hands, his eyes showing no fear, only resolve.\n\n"No—" Chen Ji wanted to scream, but found he couldn't make any sound. The visions receded like a tide, leaving only endless coldness and nausea.

dialogue.content: "Did you see it?" The assisting spirit's voice was hoarse, like dead leaves scraping together. "That is the site of the ancient pact. The Chen family ancestors and the Heavenly Eye made a blood oath—every generation of direct Chen lineage is a vessel for the Tianji Record."

text.content:
Chen Ji stared fixedly at the ancient inscriptions gradually appearing on the fragment, each character searing into his eyes like a branding iron:

'Heaven's mandate resides, secrets lie among men. Chen bloodline, inherited through generations. The eye that peers into heaven, enslaved to heavenly destiny. When the vessel is full, the soul shall scatter.'

His fingertips began to tremble. Not from fear, but from rage. Eighteen years of being atrash, eighteen years of enduring in hiding—he thought he was playing a grand game—turns out he was always just a piece on someone else's chessboard, from the moment of his birth.

dialogue.content: "The Tianji Record Fragment chose you not because of your talent, not because of your effort." The assisting spirit's remnant soul drifted before Chen Ji, his turbid eye sockets seeming to shimmer with tears. "But because of your bloodline. The Heavenly Eye needed a vessel, so it created an entire race. You thought you were the Chen family's last hope? No, you are the final sacrifice it has raised."

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, forcing himself to calm down. The fire in his chest churned like magma, yet a cold smile spread across his face. This expression even startled the assisting spirit—this wasn't the reaction someone should have upon learning their fate.\n\nThe four characters '记仇不莽' echoed in his heart. He gently stroked the Jade Pendant in his palm, feeling the warmth transmitted through the bloodline mark. Since he was a chess piece, he might as well see what cards the chess player held.

dialogue.content: "The whereabouts of the complete Tianji Record." Chen Ji opened his eyes, his voice terrifyingly calm. "You know."\n\nThis was not a question, but a certainty. His gaze was sharp as a blade, piercing directly into the assisting spirit's remnant soul. "Since you could produce this fragment, you couldn't possibly be unaware of the whole picture. Speak—which corner of the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds?"

text.content: The assisting spirit fell silent for a moment, then let out a desolate laugh: "You are more like him than I imagined."\n\nHe pointed north, toward the direction of the imperial city: "The Imperial City Forbidden Grounds, ninth level, Tianxie Hall. The place where generations of emperors suppressed the Heavenly Secrets. But there is a projection of the Heavenly Eye guarding it—ordinary people who enter meet certain death." He paused. "However, you may not be ordinary."

choice.prompt: Faced with the truth of this ancient pact, Chen Ji must make a choice—to accept fate, or to break the cycle?

choices.description: Since he was born a vessel, he will turn the tables and actively enter the game to seek the complete Tianji Record, using it as leverage to negotiate with the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the 'Vessel Awakening' state, Tianji Record foresight precision improved
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye will intensify its gaze upon you; fate reversal may arrive early

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, tucking the Jade Pendant into his chest. Fate wanted him to be a chess piece? Then he would be a chess piece that could move itself. "Very well." The corner of his mouth lifted slightly. "Since I'm destined to act in this play, I'll snatch the script and write it myself."

choices.text: Break the cycle, destroy the pact
choices.description: What of an ancient pact? Why should the Chen family's fate be decided by dead ancestors? Refuse to become a vessel; seek a way to break the contract.
choices.visible_cost: A complete break with the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Gain the 'Rebel' title; Tianji Record restrictions temporarily lifted
choices.risk_hint: The cost of breaking the pact is unknown; may affect all Chen bloodline descendants

text.content: Chen Ji violently threw the Jade Pendant to the ground, blood seeping from his palm and staining the bloodline mark. "Generations of Chen descendants have been your sacrifices for thousands of years? Enough!" His eyes burned with cold fire. "This debt, I will settle, account by account."

choices.description: There must be hidden circumstances behind the pact's signing; don't rush to take a stance, secretly investigate the Heavenly Eye's weaknesses and conditions for breaking the contract.
choices.visible_cost: More time needed to lay plans
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key clue: the Heavenly Eye is not unshakable
choices.risk_hint: The truth may be even more cruel than imagined

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a long while, then gently tucked the Jade Pendant into his chest. "I want to know more." His voice was low. "Is the ancient pact truly unresolvable? Does the Heavenly Eye... have any weaknesses?" A flash of approval appeared in the assisting spirit's eyes: "Now that is the question a wise person should ask."

Just then, Chen Ji felt a strange chill crawl from his tailbone up to the back of his skull. It was a sensation of being watched—intangible yet heavy, as if countless eyes in the void were gazing at his every move.

He knew what it was.

The Heavenly Eye. It was watching him.

dialogue.content: A cold voice rang in his mind, devoid of any emotion yet shaking his soul:\n\n"Vessel, you have awakened."

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer. His Mental Sea suddenly erupted into tumultuous waves; the Tianji Record Fragment automatically manifested, golden light blazing, clashing against that intangible gaze. A splitting headache struck, and a thin trickle of blood seeped from his nose.

This was the precursor of fate reversal. He knew it all too well.

But the corner of his mouth curved into a mocking arc—so-called Heavenly Will, it turned out, was just something that could "speak." Since it could speak, it could be deceived, provoked, exploited.

dialogue.content: The assisting spirit's remnant soul suddenly trembled violently: "It has found me..." His voice was fragmenting. "Remember, the complete Tianji Record concerns more than just one person's life—it seals within it... the Heavenly Eye's... fragment of true body..."\n\nBefore the words finished, the assisting spirit's remnant soul abruptly scattered, dissolving into specks of fluorescent light that vanished into the void.

text.content:
Chen Ji thrust out his hand, but only grasped emptiness. The assisting spirit was gone, yet his final words exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder.

The Heavenly Eye's fragment of true body.

This meant—the complete Tianji Record was not only the key to breaking his fate, but also the chain sealing the Heavenly Eye. No wonder emperors of all generations suppressed it in the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds; no wonder the Heavenly Eye was so desperate for a vessel.

It was afraid.

Chen Ji looked up at the void, that sensation of being watched still present, but now with an added hint of mockery.

"Heavenly Eye?" he silently recited in his heart. "So you can be afraid too."

He slowly wiped the blood from his nose and tucked the Jade Pendant close to his body. The Imperial City Forbidden Grounds, Tianxie Hall, the complete Tianji Record—he had to obtain them as soon as possible. He didn't know if he could withstand the next fate reversal when it came.

But one thing he was certain: this game, he had no intention of playing according to the script heaven had written.

Chen Nian's voice rang in his heart once more, trembling slightly: "Brother, I sense it... that thing is in the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds, it knows you're searching for it. It's waiting for you."

Chen Ji let out a light laugh: "Waiting for me? Then let it wait." He raised his eyes toward the north, his gaze flickering with dangerous light. "Tell it—its vessel is coming home."

The dark clouds on the horizon pressed lower and lower, as if the Heavenly Eye was reassessing this chess piece that had stopped obeying. And Chen Ji had already set foot on the road to the imperial city.
